entries.title: Project types/factoria.d.ts is a placeholder
entries.missing: types/factoria.d.ts generated by 'factoria new' is a 480-byte stub declaring modules as 'any', although AGENTS.md/scripting doc claim it contains the API typings and tell me to run tsc. The real 48KB file only comes from 'factoria api --dts'.
entries.workaround: Overwrote with output of factoria api --dts (and read docs instead).
entries.suggestion: Have 'factoria new' write the real generated d.ts, and make 'factoria validate' warn when the stub is still present.
notes: Fixed in e2b0090: factoria new writes the real generated typings; refresh with 'factoria api --dts --project .'.

entries.title: Docs mark working CLI commands as planned
entries.missing: ai-guide says 'factoria validate (planned)', 'factoria call (CLI, planned)', 'factoria run --input (planned)' and 'The factoria CLI is still being built', but all exist and work. Confusing for an AI deciding whether to use CLI or MCP.
notes: Still open after e2b0090: docs/AI_GUIDE.md still marks working CLI commands (planned); the commands work (verified).
Docs: stale (planned) markers removed from AI_GUIDE/EXTENDING.

entries.title: Bug: spawnPrefab rejects vec2 position
entries.missing: Docs (scripting.md tools example, AI guide 9.3) show world.spawnPrefab(path, {position: vec2(x,y)}) but it fails: 'Transform/position: expected [x, y, z] or {x,y,z}, got array [..' (the error is also cut off mid-value). A Vec2 is the natural 2D value.
entries.suggestion: Accept Vec2/[x,y] for Transform.position in 2D (z=0) in spawnPrefab/spawn and fix the doc examples; do not truncate error text.
notes: Fixed in e2b0090: spawn / spawnPrefab / scene.spawn accept vec2(x,y), [x,y] or [x,y,z] for Transform.position (2D z=0). Verified.

entries.title: Screen-space Text pivot confusing and template HUD text is clipped
entries.missing: In space:screen (+Y down) a Text with pivot [0,0] (the one used by the 2d-empty template title and the docs HUD example 9.4: position [24,24], pivot [0,0]) renders clipped off the top edge; [0,1] is top-left. Pivot semantics in screen space are not documented in the Text field table beyond 'top-left default [0,1]'.
entries.suggestion: Fix the template and 9.4 example, or document that pivot y=1 means top even in +Y-down screen space; add an anchor option (top-left/top-right) to screen-space UI.
notes: Still open after e2b0090: Text/Shape2D/Sprite got an 'anchor' field, but the 2d-empty template (pivot [0,0] at [24,24]) and docs/AI_GUIDE.md 9.4 still use the clipped pivot (verified: the title is cut off at the top edge).
Template HUD pivot fixed; AI_GUIDE explains screen-space anchor + pivot (Text defaults to pivot [0,1]).

entries.title: factoria call cannot reach a non-main scene after stepping
entries.missing: 'factoria call <cmd> --frames-before N' steps the main scene only; with a title->game flow a tool sees only the title screen unless --scene is given. There is no way to inject input (press action) and step between frames in a single 'call'. Also 'factoria call --help' example uses a non-existent 'Transform2D' component.
entries.workaround: tools/balance_report.js returns a hint when not in game; use --scene scenes/game.scene.json.
entries.suggestion: Add --press/--input replay to 'factoria call' (like 'run --input'), fix the help example (Transform, not Transform2D).
notes: Fixed in e2b0090: factoria call/session accept --scene, --frames-before, --press a,b and --input replay.json; use --batch to step and inspect on one engine.

entries.title: entity.behaviour is null right after spawn/spawnPrefab/game.load
entries.missing: A Behaviour is only instantiated on the next frame, so e.behaviour (and tests' game.find(id).behaviour right after game.load) is null; cannot configure a freshly spawned entity (e.g. difficulty scaling) or call its methods in the same frame. Not documented. spawnPrefab 'overrides' format for Script.props is also undocumented.
entries.workaround: Enemy.onStart pulls difficulty from the manager; tests call game.step(1) after load/spawn.
entries.suggestion: Instantiate behaviours synchronously in spawn/spawnPrefab (props applied, onStart deferred), and document Script.props overrides in spawnPrefab/world.spawn.
notes: Fixed in e2b0090: Behaviours are constructed synchronously after spawn/spawnPrefab/entity.add('Script')/game.load, with Script.props applied; e.behaviour is usable immediately (onStart still runs at the next step).

entries.title: ParticleEmitter burst silently does nothing when emitting is false
entries.missing: Docs say 'burst: particles emitted once when the emitter starts' and 'emitting: false stops spawning'. For one-shot explosions I set emitting:false + burst:N and got NO particles; the burst only fires with emitting:true (and then rate must be set to 0 to avoid continuous emission). Nothing documents this, and there is no 'one-shot / autoDestroy' option.
entries.workaround: emitting:true, rate:0, burst:N, and destroy the entity with this.after(1.2).
entries.suggestion: Document the interaction, add an 'oneShot'/'destroyWhenDone' field, and a script API emitter.burst(n).
notes: Fixed in e2b0090: ParticleEmitter.burst fires with emitting:false; use particles.burst(entity, n) or autoDestroy:true for one-shots.

entries.title: No additive blend mode / glow for neon looks
entries.missing: Sprite/Shape2D/ParticleEmitter have no blend mode (additive) and there is no bloom/post-process, so a neon look needs hand-blurred glow textures that only tint, with no light-accumulation when overlapping.
entries.workaround: Generated blurred white glow PNGs (assets/img/glow_*.png) tinted via Sprite.color.
entries.suggestion: Add blendMode (alpha|additive) on Sprite/ParticleEmitter/Shape2D and a simple bloom camera option.
notes: Partly fixed in e2b0090: blend 'additive'|'multiply' on Sprite/Shape2D/ParticleEmitter. Still open: no bloom / post-processing for a real glow.

Fixed in 40b049c (bloom half; additive blend shipped in e2b0090): set "bloom": true on the Camera (bloomThreshold, bloomIntensity, bloomRadius) over a dark clearColor and use "blend": "additive" on the bright Sprites/Shapes/particles (AI_GUIDE 9.20). The hand-blurred glow PNGs are no longer needed.
Workaround removed in 804c00d: the glow PNGs are deleted; every scene uses additive Shape2D/particles with Camera.bloom (since f649d8d the game scene sets bloomScreenSpace: false for a crisp HUD).

entries.title: Tests and headless runs write to the project's real storage save
entries.missing: storage.set in tests/runs persists to .factoria/save/storage.json of the project (my tests left lastScore=10, highScore from earlier runs, which then changed later runs and 'factoria call' output). No documented per-test isolation or 'factoria test' storage reset, no --fresh-save flag.
entries.workaround: Tests call storage.remove('highScore') at start; deleted .factoria/save manually.
entries.suggestion: Use a temporary save dir for test/headless runs by default (flag to keep), and reset storage between test files like RNG/input.
notes: Fixed in e2b0090: Tests and headless runs/calls use in-memory storage by default (fresh per test file); pass --persist-storage to use the real save file.

entries.title: Replay input format and console.log in tests undocumented
entries.missing: Docs only show {press, release} in replay JSON; mouse positions via {"mouse":{"position":[x,y]}} work (found by guessing game.input form) but unknown keys are silently ignored so I could not tell if it was supported. Test console.log output is hidden unless --log-level info is passed, not mentioned in docs.
entries.workaround: Guessed the game.input shape; used --log-level info.
entries.suggestion: Document mouse/key entries in replay files, warn on unknown replay keys, and show test console output in the report.
notes: Still open after e2b0090: unknown replay keys are still silently ignored (verified), and console.log from tests is only visible with --log-level info.
Docs: AI_GUIDE section 11 documents the input replay format (incl. mouse); factoria test now shows console output per test.

entries.title: Bloom glows the HUD too
entries.missing: Camera bloom applies to the whole finished frame, so white HUD text glows; there is no way to exclude screen-space items.
entries.suggestion: A camera flag that draws screen-space items after the bloom pass.
notes: Fixed in f649d8d: Camera.bloomScreenSpace: false draws the HUD after bloom, so it stays crisp; the game scene uses it.

entries.title: No command to save or format prefab files
entries.missing: scene.save only writes scenes; there is no command to save an entity as a prefab or to put hand-edited prefab JSON in the engine's layout.
entries.workaround: Formatted the six prefabs by hand in the compact style.
notes: Fixed in afbd0e9: prefab.save {id, path} saves an entity as a prefab in the canonical layout and scene.format {paths?, check?} rewrites or checks scene/prefab files; the hand-formatted prefabs check as canonical.

entries.title: No diamond shape in Shape2D
entries.missing: Shape2D has rectangle, circle, line and triangle only; a static diamond needs a rotated entity.
entries.workaround: Drew the chaser as a rotating square.
notes: Fixed in f649d8d: Shape2D shape 'diamond' (filled or outlined); the chaser uses it.

entries.title: Triangle rotates about its bounding-box centre
entries.missing: A spinning Shape2D triangle wobbles: pivot is relative to the size box, so the default spins it about the box centre, not its centroid.
entries.workaround: None: the ship rotated about a point slightly off its visual centre.
entries.suggestion: Document the centroid pivot or rotate triangles about their centroid.
notes: Fixed in f649d8d: pivot [0.5, 0.3333] is a triangle's centroid (documented and tested); the ship and the shooter use it.

entries.title: ParticleEmitter has no screen space
entries.missing: Particles are always world-space, so a UI burst cannot be drawn in screen space (or kept crisp in the HUD pass with bloomScreenSpace: false).
notes: Fixed in 2ff6faa: ParticleEmitter.space ("world" | "screen") and anchor, like Sprite and Shape2D. Screen particles use design pixels, keep direction/gravity as in the world (90 = up) and are drawn in the HUD pass, so Camera.bloomScreenSpace = false keeps them crisp.

entries.title: Triangle outline is centred on its edges
entries.missing: A Shape2D triangle outline pokes out of its size box by half the thickness, while rectangle, circle and diamond outlines grow inward.
entries.suggestion: Draw triangle outlines inward like the other shapes (moves existing goldens).
notes: Fixed in 2ff6faa: triangle outlines grow inward (mitred, capped at the inradius) like rectangle, diamond, polygon and star; the 2d_shapes and 2d_bloom goldens were regenerated.

entries.title: No polygon or star shape in Shape2D
entries.missing: Neon games want hexagons and stars; Shape2D has rectangle, circle, line, triangle and diamond only.
entries.suggestion: A 'polygon' shape with a number of sides, and a 'star'.
notes: Fixed in 2ff6faa: Shape2D shape "polygon" (sides, default 6) and "star" (points, default 5, innerRadius 0.5), on the ellipse inscribed in the size box, first vertex up, filled or outlined inward.

entries.title: Validate does not flag non-canonical scene files
entries.missing: scene.format --check lists non-canonical scene/prefab files but always exits 0, and project.validate says nothing, so CI must parse JSON to enforce the layout.
entries.suggestion: A validate warning or an exit-code option on scene.format check.
notes: Fixed in 6e5b5b2: scene.format {"check": true, "strict": true} fails (error not_canonical, non-zero exit from factoria call) when a file is not canonical, and project.validate warns once per non-canonical scene/prefab in scenes/ and prefabs/.

entries.title: A non-looping sheet clip cannot be looped from the component
entries.missing: SpriteAnimator.loop only matters for a numeric range; a clip from the sheet keeps the loop flag it was baked with, so the same sheet cannot loop in one entity and play once in another.
entries.workaround: Baked the shockwave as two non-looping clips and removed the entity on clipEnded.
entries.suggestion: A tri-state loop override on SpriteAnimator (inherit / loop / once).
